B28.cohort_majority_constant: per partition, the fidelity of a constant at that partition's most frequent d_model decision (an outcome-dependent reference, not a method)
B28.kappa: Cohen's kappa against d_model for each B23 input (bhat7, pca7, formal57, constant development majority) with a cluster-bootstrap interval, and the median and 95th percentile of kappa over the 1,000 random projections and the 1,000 permutations; from the frozen B23 models applied to the recorded inputs; the fidelities must reproduce the recorded B23 values exactly (numerator and denominator), else the analysis refuses
B28.label: EXPLORATORY_POST_HOC
B28.supervised_ceiling: linear discriminant analysis (4 components) fitted on acdc_dev to d_model on the 57 formal descriptors standardized on acdc_dev, followed by the B18 model (multinomial L2 logistic regression, C = 1) on the 4 scores; fidelity with Wilson interval and kappa with a cluster-bootstrap interval

B29.bounds: lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive (D49)
B29.label: EXPLORATORY_POST_HOC
B29.method: statistics.ef_categories applied to measured B and to the reconstructions; per partition the cross-tabulation, the proportion in the same category with a Wilson interval, and Cohen's kappa with a cluster-bootstrap interval

B30.b25_covered: the frozen B25 rulebook (postfreeze/B25 of v6-postfreeze-20261028-2135) re-applied to mms2_external with its frozen cuts and the routing of Section 11.7; it must reproduce 12 accepted cases and 9 agreements, else the analysis refuses; reported: the released categories of the accepted cases under statistics.min_cell, and the d_model decisions of the disagreeing cases (counts)

b25_covered.routing: Section 11.7 (route_records with the frozen cuts and the decoded stability)

B30.label: EXPLORATORY_POST_HOC
B30.mms2_categories: on mms2_external: d_model decisions per released pathology category (contracts/cohort_MMS2.parquet, pathology); per-class recall on the same-definition subset; per category, the number of cases with measured lv_ef_percent < 40 or rv_ef_percent < 40
B30.recorded_confusion: metrics/predictor_confusion.parquet of the frozen run for acdc_test and mms_external, checked against the recorded decisions and reference labels; per-class recall with Wilson intervals
B30.small_cells: D51: categories below min_cell pooled as other; other suppressed below min_cell

B31.bounds_rule: inclusive; a value below the lower or above the upper bound is outside (D49)
B31.clipped_skill: rho_j and rho with each reconstruction clipped to statistics.plausibility_bounds, beside the unclipped values, with the paired cluster-bootstrap difference
B31.counts: per partition, cases (Wilson intervals) with (i) |EF_reconstructed - EF implied by the reconstructed volumes| > statistics.ef_inconsistency_points, LV and RV; (ii) reconstructed ESV >= reconstructed EDV, LV and RV; (iii) a primary target outside statistics.plausibility_bounds, per target and in any target
B31.distribution: median, 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of EF implied minus EF reconstructed, LV and RV
B31.label: EXPLORATORY_POST_HOC

rho.estimand: v6 rho_j = 1 - MAE_model,j / MAE_mean,j (OBSERVED cells, patient weighted, acdc_dev fit-row SD and mean)

in_sample.acdc_dev_oof: in-sample and descriptive only: the reference mean and SD are those of the acdc_dev fit rows (Section 13.9 B31)
